name: Multiple-entry visit visas

activity.text_en: What is the main purpose of your repeated visits?

labels_en.holiday_family_events_transit: Tourism, family visits, participation in meetings, incentives, conventions, exhibitions or transit.
labels_en.business_meetings_negotiations_purchases: Business meetings, negotiations, agreements, purchasing goods or checking goods; no continuous supervision of production or sales.
labels_en.arts_cultural_performance: Perform arts or cultural works, including theatre or circus; no employment relationship with an Indonesian individual or corporation.
labels_en.pre_investment_surveys: Pre-investment or starting-business visits for field surveys or feasibility studies.
labels_en.film_production: Produce films, music videos, reality shows, documentaries, television, radio or similar programmes using Indonesian locations.
labels_en.company_branch_audit_inspection: Audit, production quality control or inspection of a company branch in Indonesia.

stay_days.text_en: How many days do you need to stay on each entry?

notes: Duration means days per entry; a visa valid for 1, 2 or 5 years does not permit an uninterrupted stay of that length. Initial options remain DAY, never YEAR.

D1/D2/D3/D14/D17: 60 DAY initial stay, extendable up to 180 days. Owner ruling 2026-10-19, specifically for D1/D2 one-year visas: two extensions of 60 days per entry. The Law says several extensions; it is kept verbatim.

D7: 30 DAY per entry, no extension or conversion. The page permits remuneration/facilities for the activity but forbids employment with Indonesian individuals or corporations; no blanket unpaid-only rule is invented.

D12: 180 DAY initial stay. The page says another 180 days in Jenis visa but 12 months or 2 years in Masa tinggal depending on visa duration; both passages stay quoted in the card. OWNER RULING 2026-10-19 (not verbatim Law): the maximum stay is 180 days per entry, with visa validity of 1 or 2 years; max_total_days is 180 (per entry) and max_total_months stays null. A request above 180 days per entry returns STAY_TOO_LONG.

D1/D2 have a nationality-dependent sponsor exception in the Law (sponsor_required.verbatim; the linked country list is a separate source). No country list or non-national-document sponsorship requirement is inferred. Other-document return-entry permission and tickets remain the checklist.

D12 says no sponsor for application; D1/D2 say no sponsor except listed nationalities. All three extension instructions name a sponsor. The Law inconsistency is kept in the cards; the agency-sponsor ruling below makes it moot for the Guide.
D4/D8 official pages contain Data Belum Tersedia. Their cards remain secondary, TO_VERIFY, with unknown permit, entry, sponsor, stay and sale fields; no Guide option reaches them.
Only exact D1/D2 (1, 2, 5 years) and D12 (1, 2 years) commercial keys are linked. No exact key exists for D3/D7/D14/D17, so is_sold is null. PNBP is reference only.
Application location is not stated on any substantive D page: apply_channel stays null. No ITAP entitlement is inferred from visit permits or generic conversion language; DB itap stays null.

OWNER RULING 2026-10-19 (agency_sponsors, not verbatim Law): Bali Zero is an agency and can always act as sponsor. The Guide never asks a sponsor or sponsor-exception question for D codes and never returns NEEDS_SPONSOR. The DB sponsor column keeps the Law value (REQUIRED / CONDITIONAL / NOT_REQUIRED).
